critic_runs.scope: Independent adversarial biological review of research/cytokine/pack.json and protocol/PROTOCOL.md v0.1.0; all 24 cytokine assertions and their saved primary-source evidence were inspected. This reviewer did not author the cytokine pack. This is agent review, not human adjudication.

Independent adversarial biological review of research/proteomic/pack.json and research/genomic/pack.json. The reviewer did not author either pack and did not edit them. Cytokine pack excluded because this reviewer authored it. Review addresses evidence extraction, source locators, molecular layers, evidence grades, species, context, donor reuse and null/discordant results. Integrated network and code review are separate.

Independent scientific/data-integrity and implementation review of scripts/kb.py, tests/test_kb.py and protocol/PROTOCOL.md, with scoring annotations inspected as a dependency. The reviewer authored the genomic evidence pack but did not author or edit the reviewed compiler, tests or protocol. Review focuses on hypothesis polarity, source-derived numerical gating, molecular layers, cohort reuse, entity identity, compatible paths and freeze provenance. Parent coordinator was repairing the implementation concurrently; findings identify the reviewed snapshot and are open for coordinator disposition.

adjudications.rationale: P_A06 cites main-text Fig5C line181; saved legend labels that response B. Critic recommendation was checked against original source and the B/C mismatch remains explicit.
P_A07 direction changed to association; full-text/data limitation retained.
P_A15 direction changed to association; no opposing signed estimates invented.
P_A16 direction changed to association; original limits retained.
G-A012 direction changed to association; intervention inconsistency and isoform caveat retained.
GCO02 and G-A006 now preserve source-reported European American/Caucasian analysis restriction.
GCO10 and G-A015 include IL7 5ng/mL and CD3/CD28 doses from methods.
C-A11 corrected to 24h Fig7; C-A25 preserves qualitative 7h null. See research/cytokine/review_response.json. Human adjudication pending.

Scoring annotations state tested hypotheses independently from sign. All pilot nulls are inconclusive. Inadequate absence evidence cannot update existence. Shared-hypothesis and null regression tests pass; weights remain uncalibrated.
C-A18 now protein production with compartment unavailable and needs_full_text; no numerical priors or paths. Authors terminology retained with attribution.
C-CO08 links to C-CO09 for known P1/P3 overlap. Distinct preparations and unresolved further reuse retained.
Compiler checks all supported measurement/object-layer combinations and rejects unknown measurement labels. Independent response records synthetic rejection checks; reviewed pilot passes.

Known hypothesis required; grouping uses canonical hypothesis/context/measurement rather than descriptive predicates; inconclusive records cannot inherit numerical priors. Compiled-database regressions pass.

Null/unsupported transitions, tuple bridges, unknown/reversed time and incompatible treatment are rejected. Production compiler accepts no external bridge assertions and materializes no paths; source-backed bridge ingestion remains future work.
High source/cohort ancestor/context findings quarantine dependent evidence; protocol/compiler findings conservatively withhold numerical outputs until disposition. Regression probes pass.
Coverage reports related_assertion_count and reviewed_protein_assertion_count. Neither is represented as independent direct analyte measurement or complete cytokine coverage.
